name: Event Manager

sections.daily_work: Oversee event operations and staff. Manage multiple events simultaneously. Lead planning teams. Handle client relationships. Ensure events meet budget and quality standards.
sections.learning: Team leadership, project management methodology, financial management, risk assessment, stakeholder communication, event technology, staff training and scheduling.
sections.pay: Entry-level managers typically start around $45,000-$60,000 USD. Mid-level $60,000-$90,000. Directors can earn $90,000-$140,000. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Event planning experience, hospitality management degree, project management certification (PMP), leadership roles in event teams, networking in industry associations.

try_in_real_life: Take a leadership role in planning a school or community event
Research PMP or CAPM certification requirements
Create a post-event report template: what went well, what didn't
Follow event managers on LinkedIn and read their career stories
sources: Events Industry Council salary surveys; project management institute reports
